summary: This Phase 2 clinical trial studies adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar is not well controlled on metformin therapy alone. The study evaluates the effects of Fuling Yunhua Granules and Dihuang Baoyuan Granules given alongside metformin. There are 150 participants expected to take part in this research. The trial is sponsored by Beijing Supreme Life Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.
